items.title: Crimean Bridge damage reported as rail and road traffic suspended
items.summary: Russia's transport authorities reportedly suspended both train and vehicle traffic across the Crimean Bridge while specialists assessed damage following an alleged Ukrainian strike. Images circulating online appear to show a collapsed section, but the extent of structural damage remains unverified; preliminary information indicated no casualties.

items.title: Russian security service alleges disruption of planned coordinated attacks
items.summary: Russia's Federal Security Service says it thwarted a purported Ukrainian-backed plot for simultaneous attacks inside Russia, alleging the seizure of more than 700 kilograms of explosives, at least 40 drones and six jet skis. The allegations, including the claimed Ukrainian intelligence involvement and quantities seized, have not been independently verified.
